Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to repeal and, with
certain modification re-enact the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Act,
1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 1st February, 1978]
No. Legis
1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-- (1) This Ordinance may
be called the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978

An Ordinance to repeal and, with
certain modification re-enact the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Act,
1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 1st February, 1978]
No. Legis
1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
2. Definitions.--In this Ordinance, unless there is anything
repugnant is the subject or contest,-
(a) "Commission" means
the Baluchistan Public Service Commission ; and
(b) "member" means a
member of the Commission and includes the Chairman thereof.

Composition of commission etc

ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to repeal and, with
certain modification re-enact the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Act,
1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 1st February, 1978]
No. Legis
1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
3. Composition of Commission, etc.-(1) There shall be a Baluchistan
Public Service Commission.
(2) the Governor shell by
regulations determine -
(a) the number
of members of the Commission and their conditions of service ; and
(b) the number
of members of the staff of the Commission and their conditions of services
Provided that the salary,
allowances and privileges of a member of the Commission shall not be varied to
his disadvantage during his term of office.
(3) The Chairman and other
members of the Commission shall be appointed by the Governor.
(4) Not less than one half of the
members of the Commission shall be persons who have held office in the service
of Pakistan for not lass than twenty years.

Terms of office of members etc

ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to repeal and, with
certain modification re-enact the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Act,

[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 1st February, 1978]
No. Legis
1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
4. Term of office of members,
etc.-- (1) The Governor may determine the term of office of the Chairman
and other members which shall not exceed five years ;
Provided that the Governor may
extend the team of office of the Chairman or any other member for such period,
not exceeding three years, as he may deem fit ;
Provided further that a person
holding office as Chairman or member immediately before the commencement of
this Ordinance shall cease to hold office on such date as the Governor may
direct.
(2) A member may resign his
office by writing under his hand addressed to the Governor.

Ineligibility for further employment

1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
5. Ineligibility for further appointment.---(1) On ceasing to hold
office, a member shall not be eligible for further employment in the service of
Pakistan.
(2) Nothing in subsection (1)
shall be deemed to prevent a member other than the Chairman from being
appointed as Chairman.

Removal from office

6. Removal from office.--A member shall not be removed from office
except in the manner applicable to a Judge of High Court.

Functions of the commissions

ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to repeal and, with
certain modification re-enact the Baluchistan Public Service Commission Act,
1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 1st February, 1978]
No. Legis
1-21/Law/7.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the
27th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
7. Functions of the
Commission.--The functions of the Commission shall be -
(a) to conduct tests and
examinations for recruitment to the civil service of the Province of
Baluchistan and such posts in connection with the affairs of the Province of
Baluchistan as may be prescribed by rules made under section 10 ; and
(b) to advise the Governor on
matters relating to qualifications for, and methods of recruitment to the
services and posts referred to in clause (a), and any other mattes which the
Governor may refer to the Commission.
Explanation.-In this section, "recruitment" means initial
appointment otherwise than by promotion or transfer.

Commission to be informed when its advice not accepted

8. Commission to be informed when it advice not accepted. When the
government does not accept the advice of the Commission he shall inform the
Commission accordingly.

Reports of commission

ORDINANCE II OF 1978

9. Reports of Commission.--(l) It shall be the duty of the
Commission to present to the Governor annually a report on the work done by the
Commission, and the Governor shall cause a copy of the report to be laid before
the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan.
(2) The report referred to in
subsection (1) shall be accompanied by a memorandum setting out so far as is
known to the Commission.
(a) the cases,
if any, in which the advice of the Commission was not accepted sand the reasons
therefore ; and
(b) the
matters, if any, on which the Commission ought to have boon consulted but was
not consulted and the reasons therefor.

Rules

10. Rules.--The Provincial Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, mate rules for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
